fields.v: Inconsistencies: abstract says agents achieve 'on average 30% lower success rates' in Coop, p. 3 says 'around 50% lower', App. C gives pooled retention 0.59 (41% lost); App. A.2 says '52 task sets' while Table 3 and p. 4 give 34 feature pools/PRs, and the per-repository #PRs in Table 3 sum to 32, not the stated total of 34; merge resolver is 'Qwen 3 Coder 1.5B' on p. 4 but Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B-Instruct (LoRA) in App. B and the released model name; Table 5 Coop counts do not match Table 6 with-comm percentages for GPT-5 (183/652 = 28.07% vs 27.90%) and Claude (168/652 = 25.77% vs 25.92%); communication-error prompt labels C4a twice (also used for incorrect claim). Values from Table 5 and Table 6. Data: benchmark, framework and merge resolver released (cooperbench.com; huggingface.co/CodeConflict/Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B-Merge-Resolver). No pre-registration. Programming languages: Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust

fields.why: The per-repository PR counts in Table 3 add up to 32, while the table and p. 4 state 34 feature pools; this inconsistency is not recorded.
fields.doubt: Na Tabela 3 (pág. 21) a coluna #PRs soma 32 (4+3+3+3+3+3+3+1+1+2+3+3), mas o total indicado e a pág. 4 dizem 34. Confirma e acrescenta esta inconsistência às Notas.
